transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Well, it's a burning feeling when I pass water, and I'm having to go much more often than usual. It's been bothering me for a few days now.
That sounds uncomfortable — could you tell me a bit about how much this is affecting your day-to-day life, and whether you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?

I've stopped going to the residents' coffee morning, I'm afraid — I don't want to be caught short without a toilet nearby. As for medicines, I'm allergic to trimethoprim; it gave me an itchy rash once.
Could you tell me about any medicines you take regularly or have started or changed recently, including the dose if you know it, and any past health problems, operations, or hospital stays?

I take levothyroxine, 75 micrograms each morning, and alendronic acid, 70 mg once a week for my thin bones. I also use a vaginal cream from the hospital twice a week, but I can't remember what it's called. I've got an underactive thyroid, and I had a water infection about a year ago that was treated with antibiotics — no operations that I can recall.
How bad is the burning when you pass water — if you had to give it a number from 0 to 10, what would it be?
The stinging is about a 5 out of 10, I'd say. It's uncomfortable, but I'm managing.
Have you noticed any other changes or symptoms along with the stinging and needing to go more often, and is there anything that seems to make it better or worse?

My urine looks cloudy and smells stronger than usual, though I've not seen any blood. I'm going about every hour in the day and getting up three or four times at night, when I'd normally only go once — no fever, shivers, back or side pain or vomiting, and my niece hasn't noticed any new confusion. I can't say I've noticed anything that makes it better or worse.
Is there anything else you take for your health, either regularly or something new or changed recently, that you haven’t mentioned yet?
No, that's everything — just the levothyroxine and the alendronic acid tablets, and the vaginal cream. Nothing new or changed recently that I can think of.
What worries you most about all this, and what are you hoping we can do for you today?
I think it's another water infection, like the one I had last year, and I'm hoping I can get some antibiotics — ideally before the weekend. That's what's worrying me most.
Is there anything else about your past health — such as other ongoing conditions, past illnesses, operations, or hospital stays — that you haven’t mentioned yet?
No, I don't think so — just the underactive thyroid and the thin bones, and that water infection last year. I can't recall any operations or hospital stays.
Along with the burning and needing to go more often, is there anything else you've noticed that you haven't mentioned yet?
No, I don't think I've got anything else to add — that's about the lot.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
